Implemented the hash-routed application shell with lazy route placeholders, route-level error recovery, offline status, and an accessible shared frame.

### Evidence

- `/`, `/case/:caseId`, `/case/:caseId/capture`, `/case/:caseId/recall`, and `/settings` each render their lazy placeholder; `*` renders a not-found screen whose action returns to the shelf.
- A thrown route error is caught, shows fixed recovery copy with `Reload` and `Back to shelf`, exposes no error message or stack trace, and resets when the location changes.
- `OfflineNotice` is mounted by the shell, appears on the `offline` event, clears on `online`, and initializes correctly when the page loads offline.
- The shell has exactly one `main` landmark, a first-in-tab-order skip link, and CSS that reveals the skip link on focus. The skip link focuses `main` directly so it does not collide with `HashRouter`.
- Initial shell payload excludes PixiJS and OCR code. `Case board` content appears only in the lazy `placeholders` chunk, not the entry chunk. Entry JS is 84.28 kB gzip.
- `npm run test:e2e -- e2e/smoke.spec.ts` was run as an extra browser check and passed all three viewport projects.

### Known gaps / handoff

- All route screens are intentionally placeholders in `src/app/placeholders.tsx`; feature owners should replace their lazy import in `src/app/routes.tsx`.
- `AppShell` accepts an optional `storageStatus` node for the storage-state owner; it currently renders only `OfflineNotice`.
- No Pixi board, OCR assets, domain logic, Dexie access, or feature UI was added.
